Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
WHILE WALKING ALONG THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER’S BANK ON NOVEMBER 24, 2010 (ALONG THE REVETMENT), SMALL SHEEN CIRCLES WERE OBSERVED ON THE WATER. UPON INSPECTION, IT WAS DETERMINED THE SOURCE MAY BE AN INTERMITTENT SEEP OF LIGHT NON AQUEOUS PHASE LIQUID (LNAPL) GLOBULES RESULTING FROM HISTORIC OPERATIONS AT THE FACILITY. THE SHEEN DISSIPATED QUICKLY AFTER FIRST APPEARING ON THE WATER. A SIMILAR INCIDENT OCCURRED ON NOVEMBER 10, 2010, AND WAS REPORTED TO THE NRC UNDER INCIDENT REPORT # 959615 AND LDEQ SPOC SYSTEM INCIDENT REPORT # GT01 8451. THIS AREA IS CURRENTLY BEING INVESTIGATED UNDER THE DIRECTION OF THE LDEQ (AI NO. 1708) WITH FERNANDO ITURRALDE OF LDEQ

A PIPELINE LEAK WAS REPORTED TO DCP THIS MORNING AT APPROXIMATELY 9 A.M. BY ANOTHER COMPANY. DCP FIELD OPERATOR WENT TO SITE TO INVESTIGATE AND CONFIRMED THAT IT WAS OUR PIPELINE AT APPROXIMATELY 10:00 A.M. AT APPROXIMATELY 13:30, IT WAS ALSO DISCOVERED THAT THE LEAK HAD AFFECTED A NEARBY, UNNAMED CREEK. THE PIPELINE SPILL MIGRATED FROM THE LEAK ABOUT 20' INTO A WASH AREA AND FOLLOWED THE WASH AREA APPROXIMATELY 200' TO THE CREEK. SPOTTY DEPOSITS OF CONDENSATE WERE OBSERVED IN THE CREEK FOR APPROXIMATELY 500 FEET. TWO BOOMS WERE PLACED AT THE END OF THE CREEK TO PREVENT ANY FURTHER MIGRATION OF NATURAL GAS CONDENSATE. AN ENVIRONMENTAL CLEANUP COMPANY WILL BE AT THE SITE AT APPROX. 15:30 AND WILL ASSESS WHAT PROCEDURES TO TAKE TO REMEDIATE THE AFFECTED AREA. CLEANUP WILL BEGIN IN THE MORNING.

ORIGINAL REPORT READS: UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER STATES THAT THE LEAK IS STILL ONGOING BUT ALL THE MATERIAL BEING RELEASED IS CAUGHT IN CONTAINMENT AND THE CLAMP TO SECURE THE RELEASE SHOULD BE READY TO INSTALL IN THE NEXT DAY OR TWO. Report Description///NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: WATER SPILL TO RIVER/// INCIDENT NAME: WATER SPILL TO RIVER | TWIN RIVERS PAPER | MADAWASKA RIVER | EDMUNDSTON, NB INCIDENT CATEGORY: MANUFACTURING-PULP, PAPER AND PAPERBOARD MILLS NOTIFICATION RECEIVED AT NEEC IN FRENCH – L"APPELANT RAPPORTE QU"ILS ONT CONSTATÉ QU"IL Y A DE L"EAU QUI SEMBLE SORTIR DU SOL ET SE DÉVERSE DANS LA RIVIÈRE MADAWASKA. LE DÉBIT EST ESTIMÉ À 60 GALLONS PAR MINUTE, UNE QUANTITÉ TROP ÉLEVÉ POUR ÊTRE DÛ À LA FONTE DE NEIGE, SELON L"APPELANT. L"APPELANT A PRIS DES ÉCHANTILLONS ET A FAIT DES TESTS À L"INTERNET POUR LA CONDUCTIVITÉ ET LE PH ET A ÉGALEMENT ENVOYÉ DES ÉCHANTILLONS À UN LABORATOIRE POUR FAIRE UN ESSAI SUR DAPHNIA MAGNA AINSI QU"UN TEST À LA TRUITE. L"EAU EST TRÈS CLAIRE ET LA CONDUCTIVITÉ DE L"EAU N"A RIEN DÉMONTRÉ HORS DE LA NORME, ALORS IL SOUPÇONNE QUE LA SOURCE EST UNE LIGNE D"EAU FRAICHE PROVENANT DE LA RIVIÈRE QUI PASSE SOUS LE SOL. ILS PRENNENT LES MESURES POUR OBTENIR LES PERMIS NÉCESSAIRES AFIN DE CREUSER LE SOL ET CONFIRMER LA SOURCE DE CETTE EAU. ***UNOFFICIAL TRANSLATION*** CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THEY HAVE DISCOVERED WATER THAT SEEMS TO BE POOLING FROM BELOW GROUND AND IS SPILLING INTO THE MADAWASKA RIVER. THE FLOW RATE IS ESTIMATED TO BE 60 GALLONS PER MINUTE. CALLER STATES THAT THAT FLOW RATE IS TOO ELEVATED TO BE WATER FROM SNOW MELT. CALLER HAS TAKEN SAMPLES AND RAN INTERNAL TESTS FOR PH AND WATER CONDUCTIVITY. SAMPLES HAVE ALSO BEEN SENT TO A LAB TO RUN A TROUT TEST AND A DAPNIA MAGNA TEST. CALLER REPORTS THAT THE WATER IS VERY CLEAR, AND THAT THE CONDUCTIVITY TEST DID NOT SHOW ANY RESULTS OUT OF THE NORM. THEY CURRENTLY SUSPECT THAT THE SOURCE OF THE WATER IS A LINE OF FRESH WATER THAT RUNS UNDERGROUND. THEY ARE IN THE PROCRESS OF OBTAINING PERMITS TO DIG AND CONFIRM THE SOURCE OF THE WATER.

L"APPELANT A PRIS DES ÉCHANTILLONS ET A FAIT DES TESTS À L"INTERNET POUR LA CONDUCTIVITÉ ET LE PH ET A ÉGALEMENT ENVOYÉ DES ÉCHANTILLONS À UN LABORATOIRE POUR FAIRE UN ESSAI SUR DAPHNIA MAGNA AINSI QU"UN TEST À LA TRUITE. L"EAU EST TRÈS CLAIRE ET LA CONDUCTIVITÉ DE L"EAU N"A RIEN DÉMONTRÉ HORS DE LA NORME, ALORS IL SOUPÇONNE QUE LA SOURCE EST UNE LIGNE D"EAU FRAICHE PROVENANT DE LA RIVIÈRE QUI PASSE SOUS LE SOL. ILS PRENNENT LES MESURES POUR OBTENIR LES PERMIS NÉCESSAIRES AFIN DE CREUSER LE SOL ET CONFIRMER LA SOURCE DE CETTE EAU. ***UNOFFICIAL TRANSLATION*** CALLER IS REPORTING THAT THEY HAVE DISCOVERED WATER THAT SEEMS TO BE POOLING FROM BELOW GROUND AND IS SPILLING INTO THE MADAWASKA RIVER. THE FLOW RATE IS ESTIMATED TO BE 60 GALLONS PER MINUTE. CALLER STATES THAT THAT FLOW RATE IS TOO ELEVATED TO BE WATER FROM SNOW MELT. CALLER HAS TAKEN SAMPLES AND RAN INTERNAL TESTS FOR PH AND WATER CONDUCTIVITY. SAMPLES HAVE ALSO BEEN SENT TO A LAB TO RUN A TROUT TEST AND A DAPNIA MAGNA TEST. CALLER REPORTS THAT THE WATER IS VERY CLEAR, AND THAT THE CONDUCTIVITY TEST DID NOT SHOW ANY RESULTS OUT OF THE NORM. THEY CURRENTLY SUSPECT THAT THE SOURCE OF THE WATER IS A LINE OF FRESH WATER THAT RUNS UNDERGROUND. THEY ARE IN THE PROCRESS OF OBTAINING PERMITS TO DIG AND CONFIRM THE SOURCE OF THE WATER.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 44.597033, 7.611403 (Approximated from administrative_area_level_2)
Report DescriptionCALLER ADVISED THERE IS UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF MINE TOUCH WATER (UNTREATED) THAT IS BEING RELEASED TO THE ENVIRONMENT DUE TO PIPES BURSTING DUE TO THE SNOW/COLD WEATHER. ADVISED THE PIPES ARE SUPPOSED TO HAVE A TRACING CABLE BUT THE COMPANY IS NOT MAINTAINING THEM. THE MATERIAL DOES ENTER INTO A STREAM. CALLER ADVISED THE COMPANY DRILLED SOME BORE HOLES TO THE OLD WORKING MINE (FROM 1980S) AND IS PUMPING MINE WATER TO THE OLD WORKING. THE DESIGN/WORK WAS DONE BUT IT IS NOT SURVEYED AND THE DESIGN IS DIFFERENT RESULTING IN MATERIAL POSSIBLY ENTERING INTO THE ENVIRONMENT. FORMAL COMPLAINTS WERE PREVIOUSLY MADE AND AGENTS FROM GOVERNMENT OF CANADA WERE ON SITE BUT NOT CONSTRUCTION WAS NEVER DONE. CALLER ALSO MENTIONED IN THE WATER TREATMENT PLANT THERE IS A BIOLOGICAL MEDIUM TO CHEMICALLY SEPARATE SOME OF THE MATERIAL BUT BECAUSE OF THE TEMPERATURE THOSE BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS ARE NOT WORKING PROPERLY. CALLER ALSO MENTION THE COMPANY IS POSSIBLY PLANNING ON CHANGING THE COMPANY NAME.

BOTH VEHICLES CAME TO REST ON THE RIGHT SHOULDER OF THE INTERSTATE WITH SEPARATING FROM THE INITIAL COLLISION.
